main_text.p: ram : 1 Cor. v, 7, 8. Hebr. xii, 1. 1 Petr. II, 1, 2.
5. In Dei Immutabilitate, constanter incorruptibilitatem & gloriam quæramus: Rom. II, 7.
6. Sic Deum invisibilem requiramus puro corde, ut ipsum fide videamus, ac tandem ipso fruamur: Jef. Iv, 1, 2, 3, 6. Pfal. xvi, 8, 11, 10. Matth. v, 8. Hebr. xi, 17.

7. Desideria nostra pie ad Infinitum illum, atque Æternum, excitemus, dirigamus; qui solus eâ æternum perfectissime satiare potest: Pfal. xliii, 2, 3, xxiii, 1, - xvi, 5, 8, 11. xxxvi, 8, - 11. 2 Cor. iv, 16, 17, 18. v. 1, -
8. Immensum, nobis semper præsentem, omnia etiam abstrusissima intime cognoscentium, ex animo vereamur. Hebr. iv, 11, 13. Pfal. cxxxix, 1, - 2 Chron. xxiv, 22. Job. xxi, 23.
9. Ex tenuitatis nostræ circa Dei cognitionem conscientiâ humiliemur profundissime: 1 Cor. xiii, 11, 12. Gal. iv, 8, 9. 2 Petr. I, 19.
10. In Dei Sapientiâ humiliter & pie quæramus sapientiam veram: Col. iii. 10. Jac. I, 5.
11. Sanctissimæ ipsius Voluntati nostram voluntatem subjiciamus & conformemus: Matth. vi, 10. xxvi, 42. Act. xxi, 13, 14.

12. Ex Sanctitate, Amore, Gratiâ, Misericordiâ, Patientiâ, &c. nostram ad eas virtutes analogicam conformationem discamus: Levit. xix, 2. Matth. xxii, 37. v, 44, 45. vi, 12. Gal. vi, 1. Jac. v, 19, 20.

13. Omnipotenti ejus manui nos quàm humillime submittamus; simulque impotentiam nostram agnoscentes, omnem adversus hostes nostros spirituales corroborationem in ipso quæramus: 1 Petr. v, 6. 2 Cor. xii, 9. Joh. x. 28, 29, Rom. viii, 28.
14. Supremæ Potestati Omnipotentis DeiConscientias nostras omnino, & quidem soli, subjicianus: Rom. xiv, 9, - Jerem. x, 7. Apoc. xv. 4.
